foundation.framingA.title: Uyu ndiwo musangano wedu wokutanga.
foundation.framingA.body:
Mibvunzo minomwe yakanyarara — asi unogona kumira pashure pemitatu woga kuona kuverenga kwako kokutanga.

Hapana mhinduro dzakarurama. Kuvimbika kunodarika kuita chishamiso.
Ichi haisi bvunzo. Ndiyo mufananidzo wokutanga wekwauri iye zvino, kuti ndisangane nawe ikoko.
foundation.framingB.title: Uyu ndiwo hwaro hwako.
foundation.framingB.body:
Zvaunongopa zvinoita bhendi yako yokutanga.

Mazuva anouya ndicharamba ndichigadzirisa — iyi haisi bvunzo, ndiyo mufananidzo wokutanga.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Enda mberi — ratidza kuverenga kwangu zvino
foundation.q1.title: Ndeapi emapatani aya ari kurira zvakasimba mauri iye zvino?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Kusvika ku3. Ivai vakatendeka.
foundation.q1.opt2: Kutonga — kana ndikarega kuita, zvose zvinodonha
foundation.q1.opt3: Kutiza — kuvhiringidzika, kupuruzira foni, kuva chiveve
foundation.q1.opt4: Kushushikana — kutya kumwe chete, nyaya imwe chete, fundo imwe chete
foundation.q2.title: Ndechipi chimiro chetsika chaunokwanisa kutsigira iye zvino?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Kwete chido. Zvichapihwa nehupenyu hwako hwemazuva ano chaizvo.
foundation.q2.opt1: Nyoro — tsika imwe diki, inogarika nokusingaperi
foundation.q2.opt2: Pakati nepakati — tsika yezuva nezuva, simba riri pakati nepakati
foundation.q2.opt3: Fierce — ndinoda tapas, ndinoda kuti isheve
foundation.q2.opt4: Monastic — ndinoda chikamu chikuru chezuva mukati mezvi
foundation.q3.title: Paunorota zvezvakanaka zvako, ivo vari...
foundation.q3.opt4: Vakangwara — vakanyarara, vakajeka, vamwe vanouya kwavari
foundation.q3.opt6: Kuvepo kwakanyarara uko vanhu vanopora pedyo
foundation.q4.title: Ndechipi chisi pamusuwo chiri pedyo newe ikozvino?
foundation.q4.opt6: Basa resimba — mweya, hunyanzvi hwomukati, hupenyu
foundation.q5.title: Uri pano kuzofungazve chii?
foundation.q6.title: Ndeipi inonzwikaseyo sechokwadi?
foundation.q7.title: Kana chimwe chinhu chakaoma chikaitika, unotanga kuenda kupi?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Cherechedza danho rokutanga chairo.
foundation.q7.opt1: Mumusoro mwangu — kuongorora, kuronga, kuridza zvakare
foundation.q7.opt2: Mumwoyo mangu — kunzwa, kusvika kune mumwe munhu
foundation.q7.opt3: Muchiito — kufamba, kugadzirisa, kuita chimwe chinhu
foundation.q8.title: Unoziva zvakadii kutarisa mafungiro ako ega?
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Izvi zvichachinja paunenge uchirovedza muviri. Hapana chinoramba chakamira — ndicho chinangwa chose.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Tichaverengazve izvi mazuva mashoma ega ega. Zvikwata zvinofamba. Ndicho chinangwa chose.
foundation.brain.head.label: Inotungamirirwa nemusoro
foundation.brain.heart.label: Inotungamirirwa nemwoyo
foundation.brain.gut.label: Inotungwa nemuviri
foundation.brain.head.line: Unotanga wafunga. Tichazviremekedza, tobva tadzidzisa muviri kubata zvinhu.
foundation.brain.heart.line: Unotanga wanzwa. Tichazvichengeta zvakashama, tobva tawedzera chapupu shure kwacho.
foundation.brain.gut.line: Unotanga wafamba. Tichakunonotsa zvishoma kuti unzwe zviri pasi.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Unogona kugara uchidzokera kuverenga kwako gare gare kubva kuSettings. Hapana chisingachachinja.
foundation.paths.title: Sarudza shamwari dzako.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Kutarisa ndiko hwaro — nzira yose inotangira ipapo. Sarudza nzira 2–3 dzinonzwika kuva dzipenyu kwauri ikozvino. Unogona kugara uchiwedzera zvimwe gare gare.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Kutarisa zviripo, pasina kubata kana kusunda. Nzira yose yatinofamba pamwe chete inotangira pachigaro ichi.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Iyi ndiyo nzira yako yekutanga — si cage. Nzira yako ichachinja paunenge uchichinja iwe.
foundation.archetype.creator: Musiki
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Basa remagetsi kuburikidza nekufema uye nehunyanzvi hwemukati.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Kuita pasina kusungirirwa. Basa senzira yeminamato.
